label: There is at most one first mover moved by none, by Perfect beings are not several
meaning: Unrestricted perfection and strict pure actuality make every first mover a being with every pure perfection and only pure ones; SCG I.42 as encoded makes any two such beings one. The weakest identity bridge so far: strictly weaker than identity of purely determined indiscernibles (registered strengthens). Under the background that only first movers are perfect, it is equivalent in effect to at-most-one, so it supports uniqueness only as a general claim about perfect beings. Conditional on three OPEN premises.
